sourceConflicts: 工作小食的Crafting集合表写18生命值，英文与中文独立单页均写20；采用两份单页一致的20。

records.name: 工作小食
records.limitation: 这是打造食品，不属于厨房烹饪配方；原料种子也可用于种树，需按木材需求留种。
records.versionEvidence: 1.4: Can now be used in Tailoring. Can be requested in Fish Pond quests. 1.6: Now liked by Alex.

records.name: 虫肉块
records.limitation: 会消耗本可用来制造鱼饵的虫肉；不是用虫肉直接恢复生命，也不是村民通用礼物。

records.name: 生命药水
records.materials: 红蘑菇×1、紫蘑菇×1、羊肚菌×1、鸡油菌×1
records.effect: 生命值恢复至满值，不恢复能量。
records.limitation: 1.6.4起不再恢复能量；不要沿用旧版200能量和固定90生命值的说明。矮人处成品售价为2000金，非出售回收价。
records.versionEvidence: 1.4: Can now be used in Tailoring. 1.6: Reduced sell price from data-sort-value="500">500g to data-sort-value="250">250g. Added as possible prize from Mystery Boxes and Golden Mystery Boxes. 1.6.4: No longer restores energy when consuming. The tooltip now shows it restores "100%" health instead of 90 health and 200 energy.

records.name: 蒜油
records.effect: 恢复200能量与89生命值，特殊驱怪效果持续现实时间10分钟。
records.limitation: 普通矿井中阻止生成敌人，但不包括地牢层；骷髅洞穴阻止怪物层与怪群，不排除史前层；危险矿井与危险骷髅洞穴无效。
records.versionEvidence: 1.4: Can now be used in Tailoring.

records.name: 怪兽香水
records.recipe: 完成法师特别订单“五彩胶冻”
records.effect: 持续现实时间10分钟；进入矿井或骷髅洞穴的新楼层时，使该层生成的敌人数量翻倍。
records.limitation: 不会把当前已出现的每只怪物直接复制；火山、采石场矿洞、突变虫穴的日末重置区域不能照搬同样的入层效果。
records.versionEvidence: 1.5: Introduced. 1.6: Monster Musk can now be obtained via the Bookseller. Krobus now loves Monster Musk.

records.name: 仙尘
records.recipe: 完成贝啼“海盗的妻子”任务
records.effect: 使适用机器当前正在进行的加工阶段立即完成；每次使用消耗一份仙尘。
records.limitation: 木桶熟成每次只提升到下一个品质，不能从普通直接变铱星；普通、鸵鸟、史莱姆孵化器均不适用。
records.versionEvidence: 1.5: Introduced. 1.6: Reduced sell price from data-sort-value="500">500g to data-sort-value="300">300g. Can now be obtained from Golden Fishing Treasure Chests as well as traded for with the Bookseller and the Raccoon's wife. Can now be obtained as a prize from the Prize Machine and as a reward from the Raccoon.

records.name: 传送图腾：海滩
records.effect: 一次性传送至海滩的指定落点。
records.limitation: 夏威夷宴会或月光水母起舞当天、节日尚未开始前使用，会消耗图腾但无法传送到海滩。
records.versionEvidence: 1.4: Can now be used in Tailoring. Can be produced by Fish Ponds. 1.5: Can replace clay in artifact spots. 1.6: Added as possible prize from Mystery Box.

records.name: 传送图腾：山岭
records.effect: 一次性传送至深山的指定落点。
records.limitation: 使用后即消耗，不是永久传送建筑，也不直接把玩家送进矿井任意层数。
records.versionEvidence: 1.4: Can now be used in Tailoring. Can be produced by Fish Ponds. 1.5: Can replace clay in artifact spots. 1.6: Added as possible prize from Mystery Box.

records.name: 传送图腾：农场
records.effect: 一次性传送至农场的指定落点。
records.limitation: 不要与回程魔杖或姜岛农场图腾柱混淆；赌场1.6价格是1000齐币，不是1000金币。
records.versionEvidence: 1.4: Can now be obtained from Crane Game in the Movie Theater or in Blobfish Fish Ponds. Can now be used in Tailoring. 1.5: Can now replace clay in artifact spots. 1.6: Changed Casino price from data-sort-value="500">500 to data-sort-value="1000">1,000. Now one of the prizes from Mystery Box, Golden Mystery Box, and the Trout Derby festival.

records.name: 传送图腾：沙漠
records.recipe: 沙漠商人处以10铱锭换取配方
records.effect: 一次性传送至沙漠的指定落点。
records.limitation: 配方兑换与成品兑换不同：成品可用3万能晶球兑换；传送到沙漠不等于自动获得骷髅洞穴钥匙。

records.name: 传送图腾：姜岛
records.recipe: 火山矮人处购买配方，10000金
records.effect: 一次性传送至姜岛的指定落点。
records.limitation: 制造一份需要消耗龙牙；不会自动解锁岛上桥梁、农舍等设施，应先规划返程与区域开通。
records.versionEvidence: 1.5: Introduced. 1.6: One now obtained after repairing the Farm Obelisk on Ginger Island.

records.name: 雨水图腾
records.effect: 将使用地区次日天气设为雨天；消耗一个图腾。
records.limitation: 仅影响使用所在地区；无法覆盖鹈鹕镇节日或换季第1天的固定天气。1.6起不能连锁雷暴以持续获取电池组。
records.versionEvidence: 1.4: Can now be used in Tailoring. 1.6: Fixed a bug where using a Rain Totem on a stormy day would turn the next day's weather to stormy instead of rainy; storms could be chained in this way to obtain large numbers of Battery Packs.

records.name: 宝藏图腾
records.effect: 在室外可挖掘地面使用，周围最多生成16个远古斑点。
records.limitation: 1.6.4起不能在室内使用；有障碍或不可挖掘的格子不会生成斑点，不保证每次都出现16处。
records.versionEvidence: 1.6: Introduced. 1.6.4: Can no longer use indoors.
